integrity: All-degree argument uses explicit integer normalized chain boundary, degree-one sphere attachments and a direct barcode bottleneck comparison; finite computer tests cover degrees 0–10 and do not establish the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Two-site strict directed quasi-metric only, with positive forward/backward lengths; levelwise integral homotopy and all-degree persistence barcode, plus degreewise bottleneck-to-point formula. Does not generalize to more sites or establish filtered homotopy equivalence. The motivating paper by Melodia and the Otter thesis were not materially accessible in full; literature priority remains bounded.
title: The enriched-nerve sphere filtration of an asymmetric two-point space
